editorial.blurb: A hidden gem on Devon serving exceptional Middle Eastern fare with the warm, generous spirit of its owner-chef—every plate tastes like it was made with genuine care.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask the owner, George, for his freshly made falafels and Turkish pastries while you decide on your order; he's known for offering these as gracious samples, and they're genuinely some of the best you'll find anywhere.
